name: B10-0231/2024 (S&D) – Continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns Azerbaijan for cracking down on civil society and independent media, and it names people it says are wrongly held, including Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu and the Meydan TV staff. It asks the European Union to push for their release and to attach strong human rights conditions to any partnership deal with Azerbaijan, including energy.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It concerns Azerbaijan's authorities, detained activists and journalists, and European Union representatives.
- Next, European Union officials are asked to raise these cases with Azerbaijan and review the energy deal.
